limitations: Gate M counts are probe counts until the registry-wide run lands: M.1 54/60 training families, SP-8.0 54/60 named items; M.2 21/20 evaluation families.

Seventeen families became prediction tasks (D-63 and its amendment): their objective is the interventional or end-of-episode response at held-out settings, scored 1 - MSE / variance of the truth; their public references are model-fitting procedures (refs_adapt), several of them assuming a model class (a logit demand curve, a drifting bump, a rival that follows your average price, a peaked dose law, a saturating hub, a saturating output link).

Several prediction references are weak on one seed of a seed set (ch_sign_reversal, ch_demand_shift, cxc_balancing_constraint, cxc_latched_reversal); they pass the two-of-three rule, the margin is small.
Program-execution families pay compute by measured CPU time (D-20 metering); admission values of pe_* families can vary with machine load.
The planning families of 8.4.1-8.4.3 and the routing/cascade network families (8.7.1, 8.7.4) remain static-tuning or weak-reference worlds; their redesigns were reverted.
integration_notes: program_exec compute cost consumes the parent-measured CPU of workstream O's sandbox metering; for reproducible Tier 1 admission a deterministic parent-side measure (calls x price, or quantised CPU recorded as an external event and replayed in admission) is recommended. Not changed here (O owns metering).
crucible.rapid.vec.RapidVecEnv is a learner-facing batched interface (observation_only, reward 0.0); workstream L may expose it through crucible.experience.
D-9 recreation now includes 4.0 validation families; three families moved from v5-train to v5-eval-1 (ch_sign_reversal, ch_rule_change, ch_wandering_taste).

Objective changes other workstreams see: hc_confounded, hc_feedback_hidden, ch_constraint_tightens, ch_demand_shift, ch_sign_reversal, ch_drifting_ideal, ch_tech_transition, cxc_balancing_constraint, cxc_latched_reversal, game_adaptive_rival and the four look-alike markets (mk_*) are prediction worlds in version 2 (objective predict_heldout, journal filings via the message kind; the outcome value is the prediction score). crucible.experience probes (probes.probe_rapid uses hc_confounded and ch_sign_reversal) and the research evaluator's mk_elastic example keep working (tests/test_v5_experience_oo.py and test_v5_experience_wave3.py pass on this branch); learners that assumed net income as the scored value of these families should read the objective type.
team_commons v2 (bad spells) is used by experience tests and gates (SP-11.1, SP-11.1b, OO, S): plumbing unchanged; stocks now fall during hidden spells.
tests/test_v5_research_unit.py and tests/test_v5_substrate_modes.py exceed the 5-minute direct-run budget and were not run here; they reference rapid families only through crucible.experience.

primitive_graph.true_response can now fix discrete decisions in a condition (used by the look-alike markets' certification state); fingerprints.legacy_recreation ignores journal messages of prediction worlds (D-9 still flags ch_sign_reversal, ch_rule_change, ch_wandering_taste, all evaluation families).

M.1.notes: Robustly admitted training families (all eleven checks on seeds 0-2 and 10-12): 18 on the integrated tree at the start of wave 3, 22 after the claim and identification repairs (snapshot of df2f24b). 60 are required. The binding check is no_dominant_strategy under H-D1: in most primitive-graph lever families a hindsight-tuned constant reaches >= 0.9 of the evaluator's upper reference, i.e. the worlds are static-tuning worlds; they need redesign, not a weaker criterion.

SP-0.9.notes: 18 4.0 val/test families fingerprinted from their engines; 60 v5 training families checked; 0 match by distance or mechanism recreation (recreation now also against 4.0 validation families, H-D2).

SP-7.2.notes: compose varies 11 dimensions, each verified by doing the same thing in both worlds on seeds 0-2 (with a same-recipe negative control); 6 of 6 look-alike market pairs separated by the price-response protocol.

SP-7.5.notes: Pair protocols added for the three pairs the response signature could not separate (dose response vs hypotheses, inventory vs perishable, routing vs topology shift).

SP-8.12.notes: Nine difficulty axes; batch path aggregate-routing fix.

SP-8.12b.notes: 45 of 45 batchable families equal to single worlds; a learner through RapidVecEnv runs 74,500 world-steps per CPU-s (target 20,000, H-D3) and 17x the single-world path (target 10x).

limitations: Gate M counts are far below 60 training / 20 evaluation families under the H-D1 dominance criterion; most primitive-graph lever families (hc_*, cx_*, cxc_*, cxs_*, mk_*, ch_demand_shift/tech_transition/constraint_tightens/drifting_ideal) are static-tuning worlds and need redesign so that their optimum is not a constant.
